title: PantryPilot wording test
scenario: {n} ads for the same unfamiliar app appear in your feed. Judge them on how they speak to YOU.

persona_fields.budget_context: monthly grocery budget in USD and how many paid app subscriptions they already have

scale: interest scale: 1=none, 2=slight, 3=moderate (would read more), 4=strong (would try it), 5=would sign up now. Use the range and differentiate between the ads. If truly none appeal, click="none".
